entities.summary: Glennon Doyle is an American author and queer activist known for her books Untamed, Love Warrior, Carry On, Warrior, and We Can Do Hard Things. Doyle is also the creator of the online community Momastery, and is the founder and president of Together Rising, an all-women-led nonprofit organization supporting women, families, and children in crisis.
